### Endpoints used

### Error codes and handling

| Vendor code | Meaning | Our system action | Shown to user as |
|---|---|---|---|
| {400} | {invalid payload} | {log + alert, do not retry} | {internal error, code `PAY-400`} |
| {401} | {invalid token} | {refresh token, retry 1×} | {—} |
| {409} | {duplicate} | {treat as success — idempotent} | {success} |
| {429} | {rate limited} | {backoff, retry max 3×} | {"please try again shortly"} |
| {5xx} | {vendor down} | {circuit breaker, enter dead-letter} | {"payment service is temporarily unavailable"} |

> The last column must be filled and must be consistent with `contracts/errors.catalog.json`.
> Error messages that differ per integration are a sign of missing error taxonomy.

| Our rate limit to vendor | {80 req/min — intentionally below} |
| Circuit breaker | {open after 5 consecutive failures in 60 seconds, half-open 30 seconds} |

### Mock for development & test

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Tool | {msw / WireMock / json-server} |
| Location | `tests/mocks/{vendor}/` |
| Scenarios mocked | {success, 400, 401, 429, 5xx, timeout, slow response 8 seconds} |
| When mock is used | {local + CI always; staging when vendor sandbox is down} |

> **Mocks must reproduce failures, not just success.** A mock that only returns
> 200 makes tests pass and production fail — and that is worse than no mock,
> because it gives a false sense of security.

## Checklist before SIT (per integration)

```
□ All fields in the section above are filled — no {placeholder} remaining
□ Sandbox is active and credentials have been verified to work today
□ Mock exists and covers at minimum: success, 4xx error, 5xx error, timeout
□ Mock has been compared with real API within the last 14 days
□ Timeout, retry, and idempotency have been implemented — not just documented
□ Fallback when vendor is down has been tested by disabling the mock
□ No credentials in source code or in this file
□ Our rate limit < vendor rate limit
□ Webhook (if applicable): signature verified, duplicates rejected, old events handled
```
